type:

  (∀ (x : ι), Measurable (J x)) →

        (PaperP1Registry.V2.AffineEvents.expansion_countLaw G μ J).coeff k =
          μ.real {ω | PaperP1Registry.V2.AffineEvents.expansion_count G J ω = k}) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ (PaperP1Registry.V2.AffineEvents.expansion_countLaw G μ J).coeff k) ∧
        PaperP1Registry.V2.AffineEvents.expansion_totalMass (PaperP1Registry.V2.AffineEvents.expansion_countLaw G μ J) =
            1 ∧
          PaperP1Registry.V2.AffineEvents.expansion_countLaw G μ J =
            ∑ I ∈ G.powerset,
              PaperP1Registry.V2.AffineEvents.expansion_scalar
                    (PaperP1Registry.V2.AffineEvents.expansion_centeredMoment μ J I) *
                  PaperP1Registry.V2.AffineEvents.expansion_difference ^ I.card *
                ∏ x ∈ G \ I,
                  PaperP1Registry.V2.AffineEvents.expansion_bernoulli
                    (PaperP1Registry.V2.AffineEvents.expansion_marginal μ J x)

type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] (G : Finset ι)
  (D : Finset ι → Prop) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (J : ι → Ω → Bool),
  (∀ (x : ι), Measurable (J x)) →
    PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_Hereditary D →
      D ∅ →
        PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_totalMass
              (PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_retainedReference G D μ J) =
            1 ∧
          ∃ K,
            PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_countLaw G μ J -
                  PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_retainedReference G D μ J =
                ∑ I ∈ PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_boundary G D,
                  PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_difference ^ I.card * K I ∧
              (∀ (I : Finset ι) (k : ℕ),
                  (K I).coeff k =
                    ∫ (ω : Ω),
                      (∏ x ∈ I, PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_indicator (J x ω)) *
                        if
                            PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_count
                                (PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_suffix G I) J ω =
                              k then
                          1
                        else 0 ∂μ) ∧
                ∀ (I : Finset ι),
                  (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ (K I).coeff k) ∧
                    PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_totalMass (K I) =
                        μ.real {ω | ∀ x ∈ I, J x ω = Bool.true} ∧
                      PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.expansion_l1Norm (K I) =
                        μ.real {ω | ∀ x ∈ I, J x ω = Bool.true}
